resources.string: TrueVault does not clone apps, hide them behind a fake icon, or run them from inside itself. Apps that claim to do that either need root or stop working on the next Android update. Hiding an app is something Android itself has to provide.
Choose Private Space and set its own lock.
Install the apps you want hidden inside it.
Apps in Private Space use separate app data, so you will be signed out and will need to log in again inside it. That separation is the point — it is also what TrueVault cannot do for you.
This device is managed, and its policy does not allow additional profiles. Private Space cannot be set up here, by TrueVault or by anything else.
Private Space arrived in Android 15, and this device does not offer it. TrueVault will not pretend to hide apps in its place.
Your file vault works fully whether or not Private Space is available.
